notes.title: Free update for Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy on November 19!
notes.content:
Take that! Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy is getting a free update on November 19!
Court will be back in session with quality of life updates including Episode Selection, Story Mode, as well as three additional features to enjoy in Gallery mode!

[previewyoutube=h80JKnkgRA4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ghost Trick Available Now!
notes.content:
A remastering of the supernatural puzzle-solving thriller from Shu Takumi is out now!
Check out the launch trailer! 

[previewyoutube=D5po_6bO9eg;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring
- Revived high resolution graphics
- Newly rearranged music and 1 new track
- A new collection feature for art and BGM tracks

Demo version also available!

Download the Demo - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971230/

Buy Now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967430/_/
